title: Plugins
whatIs: A plugin is a package that can add skills, slash commands and agent profiles to this project. It is different from an MCP server (a running connection that provides tools, configured in Settings) and from a single skill.
whereApplies: Plugins are installed per project folder, under .jan/agent/plugins. In Cowork, an enabled plugin's skills are added to this folder's skills: they appear in the skills list marked with the plugin's name, follow the same on/off switches, and the agent can read them. Cowork has no slash commands or project agent profiles, so a plugin's commands and agents are used only by the Flint CLI agent in this folder.
whenApplies: Installing, enabling, disabling or removing a plugin updates the skills list right away. A run already in progress keeps its tools and sees the change the next time it lists or reads a skill.
selectFolder: Choose a project folder for this session to manage its plugins.

empty.title: No plugins installed
empty.body: Install one from a folder on this computer, or from a git repository. A plugin folder contains skills/, commands/ or agents/, or a plugin.toml or .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest.

pickOne: Select a plugin to see what it contains.

details.accessSkills: Skills are instructions. A skill may include scripts; they only run if the agent runs them through the shell tool, which asks for permission as usual. Plugin skills are read-only in Cowork: edit them in the plugin's source and reinstall.
details.accessCommands: Slash commands are prompt templates for the Flint CLI agent. Using one there sends its text as a message. Cowork does not offer slash commands.
details.accessAgents: Agent profiles describe a subagent the Flint CLI agent can delegate to. A profile cannot grant tools the agent does not already have. Cowork uses only the subagents saved in Flint, not plugin profiles.
details.accessNoPermissions: Installing or enabling a plugin runs none of its files and grants no tool permissions.
details.mcpPresent: This plugin includes a .mcp.json file. Flint does not load it: plugins add no MCP servers. Configure MCP servers in Settings.

install.localNotice: Flint copies this folder into the project. Nothing is downloaded, and nothing in the folder is run.
install.gitNotice: Installing runs git clone, which contacts {{host}}. Nothing in the repository is run.
install.gitNoticeNoHost: Installing runs git clone, which contacts the repository's host. Nothing in the repository is run.
install.gitUnavailable: git was not found on this computer, so git and marketplace sources are unavailable.
install.marketplaceNotice: Installing fetches the index at {{host}}, then clones the plugin's repository from its own host. This marketplace was configured in agent.toml.
install.fetchingMarketplace: Fetching the marketplace index and cloning…

errors.pathRequired: Choose a folder to install from.
errors.urlFormat: Use an https://, ssh:// or git@host:path URL.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This deletes the folder {{path}} and everything in it.
remove.config: It also removes {{name}} from this project's disabled plugins and from any skill enable entries that name it. Other plugins and skills are not changed.
remove.sourceKept: The original folder or repository it was installed from is not touched.
